principle: The Role Fit Profile is completed once and reused across candidates. All twelve motivation supplies are collected once; candidate-specific activation happens later.

questions.Question: In which country will the employee be formally employed?
Must the candidate already be located in that country?
Can the company sponsor a candidate who requires sponsorship?
What is the preferred and latest acceptable start date?
Which working languages are genuinely necessary to perform the role, and why?
What is the actual work arrangement?
What contract type and weekly hours apply?
What must this person have achieved after six months for you to call the hire successful?
What must they have achieved after twelve months?
List the eight most important recurring tasks.
Which tasks occupy the largest share of a normal month?
Which tasks are less attractive but unavoidable?
Which tasks require independent ownership from day one?
For each capability, what level is needed at the start?
Which capabilities can be learned after joining, and within what time?
questions.Options / scale: Not trainable / 1 month / 3 months / 6 months / longer

questions.Question: What evidence would convince you that a candidate has each important capability?
questions.Options / scale: Project / work example / test / certification / interview

questions.Question: Which years-of-experience requirements are genuine proxies for capability, and which could be replaced by evidence?
Approximately what proportion of the role involves direct collaboration?
How dependent is this person’s output on work delivered by others?
Which people or functions must the person coordinate with regularly?
questions.Options / scale: Team / manager / customers / suppliers / other departments

questions.Question: How often do competing priorities or disagreements need to be resolved?
questions.Options / scale: Rarely / monthly / weekly / several times weekly / daily

questions.Question: Does the role require influencing people without formal authority? Give an example.
Select and rank up to three primary teamwork behaviours required for success; add a justified fourth only when genuinely critical.
questions.Response: Rank up to 3 + optional critical exception
questions.Options / scale: Communication / coordination / conflict / help / feedback / shared ownership

questions.Question: For each selected teamwork behaviour, what level is required and what would good behaviour look like in this team?
Describe one teamwork pattern that caused someone to struggle in this role.
How clearly are goals and responsibilities defined in practice?
How often do priorities materially change?
questions.Options / scale: Rarely / monthly / weekly / several times weekly / daily

questions.Question: How much freedom does the employee have to choose the method?
How often will the manager check in during the first three months?
questions.Options / scale: Daily / several times weekly / weekly / biweekly / monthly

questions.Question: How often does the manager normally provide feedback after onboarding?
questions.Options / scale: Weekly / biweekly / monthly / quarterly / when needed

questions.Question: How mature are the team’s processes?
questions.Options / scale: Established / mostly established / mixed / mostly being built / none established

questions.Question: How reactive is the role?
questions.Options / scale: Predictable / mostly planned / mixed / fast-changing / highly reactive

questions.Question: How broad is the responsibility?
questions.Options / scale: Deep specialist / specialist with variety / balanced / broad generalist

questions.Question: How much direct stakeholder exposure is typical?
questions.Options / scale: Limited / occasional / regular / substantial / most of role

questions.Question: Rate how much this role realistically provides for each of the twelve motivation factors.
questions.Response: One 1–5 rating for every factor; not_specified only when genuinely unresolved
questions.How used: Reusable vacancy motivation-supply profile for all candidates

questions.Question: For ratings of 1, 2, 4 or 5, add a short factual example or role reality.
What does this role not provide, despite what a candidate might assume from the title or advertisement?
questions.How used: Prevent overpromising and support candidate confirmation

weighting_process.Company action: Activate only the categories and elements relevant to this vacancy.
weighting_process.Control: Do not score irrelevant universal fields.

weighting_process.Company action: Allocate 100 points across the activated categories.
weighting_process.Control: One Match Configuration is the single source of truth.

weighting_process.Company action: Rate each active element from 1 to 5 for importance.
Classify each item as critical, important, trainable, preferred or information only.
weighting_process.Control: Critical does not mean automatic deletion.

weighting_process.Company action: For trainable items, state the time window and support available.
weighting_process.Control: Trainability never adds automatic score points.

weighting_process.Company action: Write a one-sentence rationale for any category above 30%.

weighting_process.Control: Show whether small weight changes radically reorder candidates.

weighting_process.Company action: Approve and freeze the Match Configuration for the run.
weighting_process.Control: Any later change creates a new version and audit record.
